0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>A troubled taxonomist is having second thoughts.

24.original: Show the yellow pansy concept to people around Poieten Oikos and ask their opinions.

25.original: Deliver the Ktisis Hyperboreia guidebook and the yellow pansy concept to the troubled taxonomist.

48.original: Perfect timing, familiar. I have a favor to ask of you.

49.original: It's my job to name the creations brought to us, but I can't seem to decide on one for this particular concept.

50.original: It may be because...I'm the one who designed it. It's a species of plant which I intended as a gift for my love. A clear conflict of interest, unfortunately.

51.original: My names are always fair and logical and perfectly suited to the creation. But this time, I'm not so sure. I do have a name for it, but what if it's...not suitable? What if it's too personal?

52.original: I thought of discussing the matter with my associates, but my dilemma is far too embarrassing. Would you ask if they think the name is appropriate in my stead? Don't worry─I wouldn't expect you to work without recompense.

53.original: This is the creation. A yellow pansy. And the name I have in mind is “mythos.”

54.original: Please ask around and see what people think of the name of my new flower.

56.original: My, what a pretty flower. And you said it was called “mythos”? A fine name.

57.original: Many flowers are named with a special feeling in mind, so going by what you've told me, this one is in good company.

58.original: A familiar? Do you need something?

59.original: A flower? It's beautiful! And it smells so lovely. Is it for me?

60.original: ...Oh. You just want to know if the name is suitable, do you?

61.original: Have you tried asking at Ktisis Hyperboreia? No one knows as much about naming as them.

62.original: Here's a guidebook on the subject. Take it with you, and let your master decide what to do from there.

63.original: That flower was clearly named with love. I think it's wonderful.

64.original: Take that guidebook to your master and see if they want to confer with one of the experts at Ktisis.

65.original: How did it go? What did everyone think of the name?

66.original: I see... Well, that is good to know. I won't be needing this guidebook, of course, as I can't very well ask myself for my thoughts.

67.original: Or perhaps I should. It wouldn't hurt to have some confidence in the work I do, after all.

68.original: As I created this flower, I thought of my beloved, an artist, and the stories she seeks to tell through her plays.

69.original: My hope is that, much like a myth or legend, her work is told and retold down through the ages. Hence, “mythos.”

70.original: I've decided. I'll keep the name and submit it to the Bureau of the Architect. Thank you for your help.
